result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count no longer includes cancelled purchase orders. I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example, so the change itself is untested. The existing tests matching `*PurchaseOrder*` ran and passed.

The change is in `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (`DataStore.java`, around line 6517). The count subquery now has `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the other purchase-order reports use. I also added "non-cancelled" to the method's Javadoc.

Reps with no purchase orders in the period still appear with 0, and the ordering is the same as before.
